title: Move the AE line

predict.q: Same model: C = 40 + 0.75Y, I = 60, equilibrium 400. Investment rises from 60 to 80. What is the new equilibrium income?

options.s: 415, because only three quarters of the new investment is spent
options.fb: All 20 of the investment is spent. The MPC applies to the income it creates, which is then partly re-spent.

options.s: 420, because income rises by the rise in investment
options.fb: Each rise in income is partly spent, adding more rounds: the total rise is 4 × 20 = 80.

options.s: 435, because two rounds of extra spending are added
options.fb: That stops after two rounds. Rounds continue until AE = Y again.

options.s: 480, because the rise in investment is multiplied by 4
options.fb: k = 1 ÷ (1 − 0.75) = 4, so income rises by 4 × 20 = 80, to 480.

task: Move the investment slider to 80, then the MPC slider, and watch the AE line and equilibrium move.

target.do: Move the investment slider to 80 (MPC 0.75), then press Check.

takeaway: A change in autonomous spending changes equilibrium income by the multiplier, 1 ÷ (1 − MPC), times the change.
